FRONTLINE_BUSINESS_GROUP.description: Optional Frontline VM business group name to filter the asset inventory (forwarded as the 'business_group' query parameter on /api/v2/assets). Omit to pull every asset visible to the token.

FRONTLINE_MIN_SEVERITY.description: Minimum Faraday severity bucket to import. Valid values: info, low, medium, high, critical. Forwarded to /api/v2/vulnerabilities as 'severity_gte' and additionally enforced client-side after severity normalisation (handles both Frontline's string severities and CVSS numeric scores). Default: info.

name: frontline_vm
title: Frontline VM
description: Digital Defense Frontline VM (Frontline.Cloud) importer. Lists assets via /api/v2/assets (optionally filtered by business group) and per-asset vulnerabilities via /api/v2/vulnerabilities; emits one Faraday host per Frontline asset. Severity is normalised from Frontline's string severities (informational/low/medium/high/critical) or, when only a CVSS score is provided, bucketed via the CVSS v3 ranges. Auth is token-based — set FRONTLINE_TOKEN (sent as 'Authorization: Token <token>') and FRONTLINE_HOST to the Frontline.Cloud base URL (e.g. https://vm.frontline.cloud).
